text: {"assertions":["A request timeout issue was discovered in services/auth/session_store.py on 2026-02-06 in the authentication system.","The timeout only occurred when two requests raced on the same key, signaled by a 30 second deadline in the gateway log.","Clock skew between two hosts was identified as the root cause of the request timeout problem.","The fix involved switching the deadline from a wall clock to a monotonic clock.","The fix was submitted as PR #8269 on the branch fix/request-timeout-1.","The timeout issue can be reproduced by sending two POST /login requests against a warm cache.","The fix resulted in reclaiming 63 GB of blob storage."]}
